value_formula: price(RADCQ, first OTC print within 10 trading days after 2023-10-16) / last_close - 1
confidence_reasons: last_trade_date: rests on fails rows (RAD to 20231017, RADCQ from 20231018), not an exchange print or a filing stating the last day
value_rule: worked out from decision 11 (OTC trading after the delisting); no filing states a post-delisting print
open_checks: exchange print or NYSE notice stating the last RAD trading day (2023-10-16 vs 2023-10-13)
verdict: The 2019-04-22 ending is a 1-for-20 reverse split with a CUSIP change; the real ending is the 2023-10-16 bankruptcy suspension and NYSE Form 25-NSE of 2023-10-31, valued at the first RADCQ OTC print.

verification.notes: 2019-04-18 8-K confirms 1-for-20 reverse split and no Form 25/15 in 2019; Form 25-NSE EX-99.25 (2023-10-31) confirms NYSE suspension determined 2023-10-16 after chapter 11, equity no recovery, removal 2023-11-13. last_trade_date 2023-10-16 is inferred from fails rows (RAD to 20231017, RADCQ from 20231018); 2023-10-13 remains possible if suspended pre-open.
